title: Moss and the Cool Days
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, oa, oo, 41-sound stage.

pages.brief: Close view of Moss the hedgehog's spiky brown back, in a garden with leaves starting to fall.
A garden scene with a paler autumn sun and a few fallen leaves on the ground.
Moss the hedgehog with his nose down in the soil, digging busily.
Close view of Moss the hedgehog peering closely at a patch of dark mud.
Moss the hedgehog lifting his head with a small beetle near his nose.
A garden scene with more fallen leaves scattered on the grass, a cooler grey sky.
Moss the hedgehog curled up asleep in a pile of dry leaves.
Moss the hedgehog peeking out happily from his leaf pile, autumn leaves all around.
